lessons.reason: The same retry query, document identities, judgments and eligibility versions carry a complete retrieval/ranking/policy story. Actual grade gains, changed cutoffs, shared-parameter updates, exposure subsets, conserved cap tokens and a held permission-revocation payoff perform the explanation. Every final scene was inspected. Secondary cold-start and objective-family panels, the caption-only underfill alternative, long settled holds and a short final pause retain earned deductions; no material visual or teaching blocker was observed.
